name: What should I ask before hiring a commercial builder?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask before hiring a commercial builder for a project in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask before hiring a commercial builder for a project in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a commercial builder, owners should ask questions that reveal how the team actually manages a project. Useful questions include whether the contractor has completed similar work, how they handle permits and inspections, how change orders are priced, and what is excluded from the bid. It is also smart to ask about staffing, subcontractor management, safety procedures, and how the schedule is protected when unexpected issues arise. In Los Angeles, Glendale, Pasadena, Burbank, and North Hollywood, local permit familiarity can make a real difference because even small jobs can require detailed coordination. Owners should also ask whether the contractor can work in occupied spaces, how they handle long-lead items, and what communication cadence they use during construction. The best contractor is the one that is transparent about scope, predictable about process, and realistic about risk.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar project experience, local permit handling, insurance, subcontractor coordination, schedule management, change order process, and what is excluded from the bid. Also ask whether they have completed work in your specific city and building type. Clear answers reveal whether the builder can handle the project without avoidable surprises.
